cases.name: Maria Inez Soto
cases.about: Maria Soto took care of others. It was a motherly love that she had. Maria’s daughters are recalling those precious moments spent with their mom. “I’d lay down with her sometimes… She’d stroke my hair and hold me,” Chelsea said. “That’s what I miss the most.” Even the moments that kids hate – the nagging from their parents. “I miss her yelling at me,” Chelsea jokes. It was in Maria’s nature to share her motherly love. She did it with a smile on her face. If there’s something to remember Maria by, her daughters say it’s this: “Her hair and her laugh. Her laugh, she had like a loud laugh. Everyone that knows her knows she was always joking around.”
cases.narrative: On 7/21/2021, her daughter's boyfriend discovered her body after she did not pick him up from work. Big Spring Police Officers discovered Soto dead on her sofa with numerous stab wounds.
